comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a single filer whose Form 1040 line 12 blindness checkbox is ticked — the box the service attested FALSE and published as an assumption until this unit. Line 12 = 17,750 = the 15,750 basic amount + the 2,000 additional amount an unmarried filer gets for blindness (IRC 63(f)(2)(A)); taxable 34,250 = 52,000 − 17,750; income tax 3,875 = table(34,275 midpoint: 1,192.50 + 12% × 22,350 = 3,874.50, rounded half up); withholding 5,400; overpayment 1,525. The same wages with the box unticked are wages-single-mid: line 12 = 15,750, tax 4,115 — the 240 (12% of 2,000) this filer was entitled to and, before could not answer for.
